thread:
alex: Quick async sync - SAO2 (sao-east-1b) onboarding checklist. Need owners for privconnect, egress policy, KMS/residency, and canary plan. Target cutover window: 2026-04-08 to 04-10. Who's taking what?
maria: I can own routing policy & peering handoff. I'll coordinate with infra and legal. Questions: do we require egress restrictions to block external S3 buckets by default?
tim: infra take privconnect + peering setup. Need the PO for the dedicated cross-account role and the IP blocks. Also will open a ticket for the VPN -> privconnect backstop.
jen: security note: for SAO2 we need KMS key policy that restricts key usage to the region tenant. Also retention of audit logs (90d min). I'll add the policy template to the playbook.
kevin: for model serving, we need capacity profile: 8xV100-equivalent reserved to start. We'll test quantized model path; please tag nodes with `redwood:model-serving=sao2` so autoscale can pick them.
lia: SRE can run canary and smoke. Proposed canary config:```yaml
canary:
  traffic: 2%
  duration: 30m
  rollback_on: error_rate>1% or p95>400ms
```
I'll also add a quick runbook for failover to `sao-west-1` if capacity dips.
deploy-bot: Pipeline created: `sao2-canary-2026-04-07` by @lia. CI artifacts: 3 images. Status: queued.
alex: Thanks. maria - can you paste the owner list and attach the draft playbook link? tim - please confirm privconnect ETA. jen - last check: is HSM mandatory or optional for this region?
maria: Owners: routing= @maria, privconnect liaison= @tim, egress policy= @maria, kms/security= @jen, sres/canary= @lia, ml-capacity= @kevin, legal= @nicole-legal. Playbook draft: https://redwood.internal/ops/playbooks/sao2-onboard-draft (WIP).
tim: Privconnect ETA: requesting allocation this week, target provisioning by 2026-04-02. Need acceptance of cross-account role ARN from the tenant owner.
jen: HSM is optional for now but required for customers with compliance tier C. We'll enable KMS with stringent key policy by default; if customer requires HSM we'll add a KMS-backed HSM flow.
kevin: Can we get a nodal tag convention? I'll rely on `redwood:model-serving` + `pool=dedicated`.
lia: ACK on tags. I'll wire autoscale policies to match `pool=dedicated` and `region=sao2`.
alex: Ok - action items: 1) maria to finalize playbook + egress defaults (due 2026-03-30) 2) tim to provision privconnect + role (ETA 2026-04-02) 3) jen to push KMS template and audit checklist (2026-03-31) 4) kevin to confirm capacity test plan and images (2026-04-03) 5) lia to create canary run and attach rollback hooks (before cutover). I'll ping code owners for CRs.
maria: I'll add a short CR for the route policy (PR coming in ~30m). Ping @eng-releases for schedule slot. :muscle:
tim: opening infra ticket INFRA-4832 with the privconnect details and IP ranges.
jen: I'll upload the key policy here once drafted.
alex: Thanks everyone — posting this as the single source. If anyone wants a short async sync later today, I'm free 16:00-16:30 UTC.
